info.name: Virtual Library API — API Collection
info.description:
Complete step-by-step Postman collection for the Node.js Virtual Library API.

 Testing Order (run top-to-bottom):
  Phase 1  — Health Check
  Phase 2  — User Registration & Auth
  Phase 3  — User Profile & Account Management
  Phase 4  — Admin Operations
  Phase 5  — Authors (CRUD)
  Phase 6  — Books (CRUD)
  Phase 7  — Teardown / Cleanup

  How To Use:
  1. Import this file into Postman.
  2. Set the 'baseUrl' Collection Variable to your server (default: http://localhost:8000).
  3. Run the entire collection with 'Collection Runner' in order.
  4. Each request auto-saves IDs / tokens into Collection Variables via Tests scripts.

 Variables automatically populated during the run:
  userToken, adminToken, authorToken
  userId, adminUserId, createdAuthorId, createdBookId, createdAuthorUserId
